title: Clipboard formats
description:
Pick the best clipboard format your program understands from what is offered.

```
offered: CF_UNICODETEXT, HTML Format, CF_TEXT
we understand: HTML Format, CF_UNICODETEXT
-> paste as HTML Format
offered only CF_BITMAP -> nothing to paste (button disabled)
```
hints: Loop over `preferred` (not `offered`), and return the first one found in `offered` (lesson 5.05).
`GetPriorityClipboardFormat` does exactly this with format numbers.
requirements: Formats are names (standard ones and registered ones like `HTML Format`).
Our list is in order of preference; choose the first that is offered.
Explain in a comment why `CF_UNICODETEXT` is preferred over `CF_TEXT`.
stretch: Put two formats on the clipboard when copying, so other programs can choose.
